description: Hugging Face LeRobot end to end: install, hardware bring-up, dataset recording, training, and deploying robot learning policies. Use this skill when the user mentions LeRobot, lerobot-record, lerobot-train, lerobot-rollout, lerobot-teleoperate, lerobot-calibrate, lerobot-setup-motors, lerobot-find-port, lerobot-find-cameras, lerobot-eval, lerobot-edit-dataset, LeRobotDataset, SO-100, SO-101, SO-ARM100, Koch, LeKiwi, OMX, OpenArm, Feetech STS3215 servos, leader/follower teleoperation, calibration files, ACT, Diffusion Policy, SmolVLA, pi0/pi0.5, GR00T or X-VLA fine-tuning in LeRobot, robot datasets on the Hugging Face Hub, dataset v2.1 to v3.0 conversion, RTC or remote (async) inference, or HIL-SERL in LeRobot. Also trigger on LeRobot errors such as calibration mismatch, FrameTimestampError or timestamp tolerance violations, camera or feature name mismatch between dataset and policy, missing q01/q99 stats, and Feetech "Incorrect status packet".
